# @APP_NAME@ - a Vue-style LVGL application (generated by tools/new-app.sh)
#
#   tools/build-deps.sh      # build the framework's dependencies first
#   cmake -S . -B build && cmake --build build
#
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(@APP_CNAME@
        VERSION 0.1.0
        LANGUAGES C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

option(SHREWD_APP_AS_THREAD
        "Build as a library exposing gui_thread() instead of a standalone main()"
        OFF)

find_package(shrewd-lv-view CONFIG REQUIRED)

set(APP_SOURCES
        src/app.c
        src/views/home.c)

if(SHREWD_APP_AS_THREAD)
    list(APPEND APP_SOURCES src/app_thread.c)
    add_library(@APP_CNAME@ STATIC ${APP_SOURCES})
else()
    list(APPEND APP_SOURCES src/main.c)
    add_executable(@APP_CNAME@ ${APP_SOURCES})
endif()

target_include_directories(@APP_CNAME@ PUBLIC src)
target_link_libraries(@APP_CNAME@ PUBLIC shrewd-lv-view::shrewd-lv-view)

if(SHREWD_APP_BUILD_TESTS)
    enable_testing()
    add_subdirectory(tests)
endif()
